notes.title: The sixth small patch is here!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Today we made more minor bug fixes and adjustments:


 Adjustment: The maximum shadow distance has been optimized for medium and low graphics settings for better game performance.
 Adjustment: The Gravity Gun can now bring objects closer or further away while carrying them, making storage even easier.
 Adjustment: Due to the adjustment of the Gravity Gun, the Sprint button for gamepads had to be remapped to pressing the left joystick.

notes.title: The fifth small patch is here!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Today we made more minor bug fixes and adjustments:


 Fix: The garbage container no longer collides during placement and can break or move items.
 Adjustment: You can now more easily see how many credits you still need for your well-deserved vacation on The Isle.
 Adjustment: The prices in the shop have been adjusted.
 Fixes & Adjustments: Various minor adjustments and fixes.

notes.title: The fourth small patch is here!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Today we made more minor bug fixes and adjustments:


 Adjustment: Simplified controls for the Gravity Gun via the settings. With the toggle, you don't have to hold down the button to move and rotate objects. Tapping the button is enough to start and stop moving and rotating.
 Adjustment: If the game is too difficult for you, you can now also activate the reduced energy consumption of the Gravity Gun in the settings.
 Fix: You can now rotate objects while walking again!
 Fix: Customers' items should no longer fall out of the drop-off area if there is still enough space for them.

notes.title: The third patch is here!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Today we've made more minor bug fixes and adjustments:


 Adjustments: The boundaries of the building sites disappear after construction to be less of a hindrance.
 Adjustments: Your vacation on The Isle has been renegotiated for you!
 Fixes & Adjustments: Various minor adjustments and fixes.

notes.title: The next small patch is here!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Today we've made more minor bug fixes and adjustments:


 Adjustments: Improved item icons: The toy trains have new ID photos to make them easier to distinguish.
 Fix: Fixed floor texture decals: On low and medium settings, the items are no longer incorrectly displayed as dirty.

notes.title: The first patch is here!
notes.notes:
🛠️ Barely released, and the first small bug fix patch is already here 🛠️


 Fix: Improved item drop-off: Customers now check more closely to make sure they're actually picking up everything, we promise!
 Fix: Jumping and crouching: RID-8952's joints have been re-oiled and can now always jump and sneak correctly again.
 Change: The storage shelf is shy and prefers not to have customer contact. Therefore, it can only be placed in storage units.
